'''Road Plunderer''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|An armed criminal active in the jurisdiction of Wuling City. Road Plunderers would usually set up illegal road barricades or engage in the smuggling of illegal goods. Eliminating these brigands is a top priority for the law enforcement forces of Hongshan.}}

==Overview==
One of the basic melee [[Cangzei Pirate]]s, Road Plunderers are similar to [[Bonekrusher Raider]]s in terms of being a fodder enemy; They attack with either an upward swing or a slam, dealing Physical damage.
